title: Law to require lighting under elevated structures
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to study lighting conditions under elevated structures like bridges and overpasses every five years and install pedestrian lighting where sidewalks lack sufficient light, if feasible. Sufficient lighting is defined as at least 1 footcandle along the entire sidewalk. DOT would have one year after its first assessment, or three years after the initial study, to install lighting and must report findings to the Council and mayor.
